verdict.rationale: Gecko Security is an AI code-security scanner. A buyer could reasonably ask a security-scanning product about container image scanning, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents source-code analysis of repositories and ZIP uploads (call chains, endpoint maps, PR checks), with nothing on scanning container images for OS-package or application-layer vulnerabilities. The digest-pinned image_ref in the releases API is for retrieving Gecko's own release image, not for scanning user images, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can scan container images for OS-package and application-layer vulnerabilities before deploying them
